Related, but no single clause overlaps strongly. Cite it if you rely on it.
Call propose_decision with `treats` for every clause you really change (set `kind` to AMENDS
if you only narrow it, and give a `reason`) and `cites` for what you build on. The graph then
reports who relies on what you overrule.
